text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Man
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your debut, Sirius.
I also have letters for you from your father and your teacher.
You should read them later.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
How polite.
...Though it's unexpected for you to go out of your way to greet me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The moon has been quite bright lately.
Putting the old man and Sensei aside, I assumed most folks in our household would be absorbed in moon-viewing, though.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Man
text_block_list.text: Haha, as harsh as ever, I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Man
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, Symboli Rudolf claimed the
Japanese Derby with an undefeated six-race streak—

The Japan Derby is one of the Classic Triple Crown races.
Winning the Classic Triple Crown
is considered a tremendous honor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Man
text_block_list.text:
People have even begun to say
that she might already surpass
Mr. C.B.

And Symboli Rudolf is a genius Umamusume
belonging to the Symboli household,
currently carrying immense expectations in the racing world.
She and Sirius Symboli are childhood friends, but they don't seem to get along very well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Man
text_block_list.text:
"...As if I could ever
forget the day of your debut."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Man
text_block_list.text:
We have high hopes for you as well.
We certainly do not believe you lack the ability.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Man
text_block_list.text:
"You have what it takes to claim the Japanese Derby.
—I wish you the best of luck, Sirius."
After giving a polite greeting, the Symboli family gentleman left behind a gift and made his way to the spectator seats.
choice_data_list: People have high expectations of you.
People have high expectations of you, huh?

text_block_list.text: It's quite rare for someone to have hopes pinned on them for the Japanese Derby before they've even debuted.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Like I care.
I'm not running for their sake.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I don't carry useless baggage.
Don't go letting weird things drag you down either.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Our only goal must be the pinnacle of the world,
nothing else."
She turned her sharp gaze down the road ahead. Beyond the light, the air was already buzzing with excitement.
